$comment: Component manifest for the one-plugin bundle. Every entry is fetched from an
official vendor source and verified before use. Fields:
sha256   - REQUIRED for offline integrity. 'unverified' means the vendor does
not publish a checksum we could confirm; setup then pins the hash
it observed on first fetch (TOFU) and fails on later mismatch.
size     - expected byte count, used only for progress/truncation checks.
license  - license of the 'from' declaration, not a redistribution claim.
requires - components whose binaries this one needs to run.
Nothing here is redistributed inside the npm package; setup downloads it.

node.description: Portable Node.js runtime used to execute vendored REA. Only provisioned when no compatible node.exe is already reachable.

win32-x64.note: Checksum and unpack verified on this machine: the extracted node.exe runs standalone (v24.21.0), no installer and no registry writes.

linux-x64.note: .tar.xz is not unpackable by Windows Expand-Archive; bsdtar handles it.

jdk.description: Full JDK (not a JRE) for Ghidra headless and the JADX bridge. REA validates it with 'java --list-modules' and requires jdk.compiler.

ghidra.description: Ghidra release, extracted. REA locates support/analyzeHeadless(.bat) and Features/Decompiler/os/<platform>/decompile[.exe] inside it.

all.sha256Source: GitHub release body of the pinned tag: api.github.com/repos/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra/releases/tags/Ghidra_12.1.4_build -> .body, line '* SHA-256: `ddac49f9...`'. No checksum asset exists (six candidate names 404). Always read the pinned tag, never releases/latest, because the body changes.
all.note: No platform split for the public release: one zip serves Windows/macOS/Linux. ~570 MB, the single largest component; never redistributed inside the npm package. Windows traps: a path containing '!' or '^' breaks Ghidra, and macOS native components are not shipped (they must be built with support/gradle/gradlew buildNatives).

apktool.description: Android resource decoding. REA is pointed at the wrapper script, which must sit next to the jar.

all.sha256Source: Vendor-published in the 3.0.3 release post (apktool.org/blog/apktool-3.0.3/), md5 50d98c920b005d2fcdc18d3d52e3f23b. Independently reproduced here: this is the hash of the 15,478,013-byte apktool_3.0.3.jar.

win32-x64.sha256Source: measured on 2026-10-13 (raw.githubusercontent.com publishes no checksum); archive-free single file, 2,348 B
notes: The wrapper pushd's to its own directory and resolves apktool.jar first, then globs apktool_*.jar, so the renamed jar next to it is found.

Its final line is `for %%i in (%cmdcmdline%) do if /i "%%~i"=="/c" pause & exit /b`: measured here it returns exit 0 in 0.2 s, but it appends 'Press any key to continue . . .' to stdout. That trailing text is upstream's, not a provisioning defect; tools that parse apktool's stdout should tolerate it.
REA is pointed at this .bat (REA_APKTOOL_COMMAND), not at the jar, exactly as the wrapper expects.

darwin-arm64.sha256Source: raw.githubusercontent.com (no published checksum); TOFU pin on first fetch

linux-x64.sha256Source: raw.githubusercontent.com (no published checksum); TOFU pin on first fetch

jadxHeadlessMcp.description: REA validates this exact jar's bridge classes; it is not interchangeable with a plain jadx build.

all.sha256Source: Vendor-published sidecar asset releases/download/v0.7.1/jadx-headless-mcp.sha256 (98 bytes, one line); the value was independently reproduced here by hashing the downloaded 42,619,858-byte jar. 0.7.1 is the newest release and REA requires exactly this bridge build: the project's own build.gradle.kts documents that the fat jar must be shaded with duplicatesStrategy INCLUDE, otherwise only KotlinMetadataPlugin registers and every APK resolves to a single R class. Versions 0.6.0 and earlier predate that fix.

androidPlatformTools.description: adb, for REA's device tools. Optional: without a device these tools simply report no devices.

win32-x64.sha256Source: Google publishes no checksum for this rolling asset; this value was measured on 2026-10-13 (Content-Length 8,044,989 B confirmed by HEAD) and the archive was verified readable (15 entries incl. adb.exe). The archive's own platform-tools/source.properties reports Pkg.Revision=37.0.1, so the pin is really 'platform-tools 37.0.1'. Because -latest- moves, setup re-verifies against this recorded value and reports drift instead of silently accepting new bytes; Google's repository2-3.xml carries size+checksum for versioned archives if a vendor hash is ever required.
win32-x64.note: Rolling 'latest' URL pinned by observation. Android SDK components are not OSI-licensed and Google restricts redistribution, so this is fetched from Google at install time and never re-hosted. Contents also include fastboot, sqlite3, mke2fs and the USB API DLLs.

darwin-x64.sha256Source: Google publishes no checksum for this rolling asset

linux-x64.sha256Source: Google publishes no checksum for this rolling asset

reaAgents.description: The REA MCP server itself, installed into vendor/ from the npm registry so the bundle owns the runtime copy.

npm.integrity: registry-provided (npm verifies the tarball signature/integrity itself)
npm.sha256Source: npm registry integrity field is authoritative for the tarball; setup records the resolved dist.tarball + integrity it saw

notProvisionable.$comment: Upstream host gates. Listed so the setup report can explain an unavailable capability instead of silently omitting it.
notProvisionable.ida: requires a user-owned IDA plus REA_IDA_MCP_CONFIG; REA never launches IDA.
notProvisionable.pwntools: Linux x64 only (REA_PWNTOOLS_PYTHON) — ELF layout and recorded-crash tools.
notProvisionable.mitmdump: Linux only, native mitmproxy captures (REA_MITMDUMP_COMMAND); HAR needs no engine.
notProvisionable.appleToolchain: macOS only (xcrun, plutil, assetutil, hdiutil, lldb).
notProvisionable.ilspycmd: Optional .NET decompiler (REA_ILSPY_CMD_PATH). Only wired when a runnable ilspycmd already exists; the static managed provider works without it.
notProvisionable.browser: Reused from the host (REA_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE). Never downloaded by this bundle.
